# Guest instruction addresses (hex). Every guest memory access of a function containing one of
# these keeps the inline 16-byte-crossing check (see tools/peephole_guest_code.py); elsewhere an
# access that crosses 16 bytes costs a fault (about 2 us). The runtime logs the sites that fault
# as "[tso] ... top guest sites", and GOW3_TSO_SITES=<file> writes all of them.
# 2026-10-25: from loading the Mount Olympus save and walking there (~200,000 faults/s without
# this list).
